captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a railway-crossing gate featuring a dark gray square concrete base, a black cylindrical post, and a black support bracket housing a revolute pivot joint. The boom arm is a long, square-profile beam decorated with alternating red and white warning stripes. The arm rotates vertically about the pivot pin on the support bracket, transitioning from a horizontal blocking position to a vertical open position.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an articulated railway-crossing gate. It should feature a solid rectangular concrete base, a black vertical support pillar, a hinge bracket at the top, and a long striped red-and-white boom arm attached via a revolute joint to pivot vertically.
captions.factory: The model is constructed as an assembly with two main parts connected by a revolute joint. The base link consists of a concrete footing (Box), a vertical post (Cylinder), and a hinge bracket composed of a backplate and two side plates (Boxes) with a pivot cylinder. The moving boom link is built by creating a main long square beam (Box) and then overlaying alternating red and white warning segments (Boxes) along its length, pivoted around a central cylinder pin.
